name: Viking

description: Break the enemy line with roaring warcries, crushing charges, and a whirlwind of steel. The Viking strengthens nearby allies while turning brutal weapon strikes, stunning shockwaves, and the cold power of Ymir into relentless pressure.

skills.description: Blood surge now causes its target to release blood tendrils for a portion of its damage.

name: Shaman
title: Voice of the Elements
description: Call to the earth, and let the elements answer. The Shaman tears open the ground, sends tornadoes through enemy ranks, and gathers elemental totems and spirit wolves into a fighting circle of stone, fire, and lightning.

skills.name: Tectonic Boulder
skills.description: Unleash a massive boulder that travels forward dealing arcane damage.

skills.name: Twisters
skills.description: Unleash small twisters towards target location dealing arcane damage to monsters on their path.

skills.name: Rock Fragments
skills.description: Unleash rock fragments towards target location dealing arcane damage.

skills.name: Earth Bind
skills.description: Raise vines from the ground dealing poison damage, poisoning and rooting monsters in place.

skills.name: Tornado
skills.description: Summon a tornado traveling towards target direction dealing arcane damage to monsters on its path.

skills.name: Earth's Grace
skills.description: Increases your maximum life and mana.

skills.name: Meteor Storm
skills.description: Call down a meteor storm on target location dealing arcane damage.

skills.name: Nature's Prophet
skills.description: Increases your arcane skill damage.

skills.name: Fissures
skills.description: Rip the ground open with magic causing cracks that release fissures dealing arcane damage.

skills.name: Earth Totem
skills.description: Summon a totem that fires rock fragments that deal area of effect arcane damage on hit.

skills.name: Spiritual Guide
skills.description: Increases your mana and mana replenish.

skills.name: Storm Totem
skills.description: Summon a totem that releases chain lightning on nearby monsters dealing lightning damage.

skills.name: Spirit Wolves
skills.description: Spawn a spirit wolf to fight on your side.

skills.name: Scent of the Wolf
skills.description: Increases spirit wolves arcane damage and life.

skills.name: Fire Totem
skills.description: Spawn a totem that casts piercing fire projectiles dealing fire damage.

skills.name: Fractal Mind
skills.description: Increases your movement speed and magic skill damage.

skills.name: Astral Intellect
skills.description: Cast to move all spawned totems to you. Passively increases the attack range of all totems.

skills.name: Chaos Totem
skills.description: Summon a totem that rapidly shoots chaos bolts dealing arcane damage.

name: White Mage
title: Grace and Damnation
description: Offer sanctuary in sacred light, or open the door to something darker. The White Mage heals and shields allies with divine power, while its unholy arts mark enemies, unleash restless spirits, and tear life and mana from souls.

skills.name: Satan’s Mark
skills.description: Mark the monsters on target area for satan causing them to unleash pulses of arcane damage when struck by other abilities and attacks.

skills.name: Restless Spirits
skills.description: Unleash restless spirits from an unholy dimension to seek new hosts inflicting arcane damage to the target.

skills.name: Digest Souls
skills.description: By sacrificing your victims to the devil temporarily gain increased movement speed and arcane skill damage after killing a monster.

skills.name: Shadow Bolt
skills.description: Gather your inner darkness and unleash a powerful piercing shadow bolt that deals arcane damage to monsters on its path. The shadow bolt slows down after hitting a target.

skills.name: Soul Spurn
skills.description: Rip the souls from nearest monsters dealing arcane damage and restoring your life and mana.

skills.name: Martyr
skills.description: Sacrifice your own blood when taking damage from any source temporarily increasing your life and mana replenish.

skills.name: Dark Oath
skills.description: Conjure an aura that unleashes waves of unholy energy around you inflicting arcane damage to nearby monsters.

skills.name: Malediction
skills.description: Your unholy essence drives birds into insanity, casts have a chance to send crows towards random nearby monsters exploding into arcane damage on impact.

skills.name: Black Mass
skills.description: Summon all the coven's cultists to march in the name of satan inflicting arcane damage to monsters on their path.

skills.name: Heavenly Fire
skills.description: Light the target location into holy fire dealing arcane damage.

skills.name: Burst of Light
skills.description: Cast a ray of divine light dealing arcane damage and lights monsters on heavenly fire.

skills.name: Flash Heal
skills.description: Heal yourself and any nearby allies.

skills.name: Benediction
skills.description: When healed by your abilities, smite monsters around you with holy lightning.

skills.name: Divine Healing
skills.description: Using flash heal temporarily increases your life replenish.

skills.name: Chain of Holy Lightning
skills.description: Cast a holy lightning jumping from monster to monster dealing arcane damage.

skills.name: Holy Shield
skills.description: By the power of god bless yourself and any nearby allies with immortality for a short period.

skills.name: Healing Zone
skills.description: Bless the area around you with divine energy healing yourself and nearby allies.

skills.name: Mana Orb
skills.description: Summon a pulsating orb of mana that replenishes mana for players and deals arcane damage to monsters.

name: Marauder
title: Chains of Ruin
description: Turn every chain into a sentence and every bomb into its execution. The Marauder swings heavy flails, scatters explosives, and binds enemies with nets and serrated chains before tearing the trapped ranks apart.

skills.name: Heavy Ball
skills.description: Flail a big chained spike ball dealing physical damage to monsters on its path.

skills.name: Bouncing Grenade
skills.description: Throw a grenade that bounces exploding into shrapnel on impact, dealing area of effect fire damage.

skills.name: Unstable Bomb
skills.description: All bombs scatter small bombs around when exploding dealing fire damage.

skills.name: The Big Bo-oM
skills.description: Throw a huge bo-omb scattering into shrapnel on impact dealing area of effect fire damage.

skills.name: Wrecking Ball
skills.description: Increases the damage and range of Heavy Ball.

skills.name: Crazy Grapple
skills.description: Throw a massive spike ball into target location dealing area of effect fire damage and dragging yourself towards it through the air.

skills.name: Flail Mastery
skills.description: Increase attack speed, attack damage and cast rate when using mace weapons.

skills.name: Bombardment
skills.description: Rapidly throw a barrage of small bombs in target direction dealing area of effect fire damage.

skills.name: Force Overwhelming
skills.description: Temporarily increase your attack damage, attack rating and attack speed.

skills.name: Serrated Chains
skills.description: Perform an area of effect attack with increased attack rating and damage attaching serrated chains to monsters.

skills.name: Retiarius Net
skills.description: Throw a retiarius net dealing area of effect arcane damage and stunning monsters hit.

skills.name: Chain Trap
skills.description: Throw a chain trap into the target location dealing arcane damage and hooking nearby monsters with chains.

skills.name: Titanium Chains
skills.description: Monsters affected by Serrated Chains explode upon death dealing physical damage.

skills.name: Master Trap Maker
skills.description: Passively increases the arcane damage dealt by chain traps and provides a chance for critical hits as well as a proc chance for traps to activate rapidly causing the trap and its hooks to travel faster.

skills.name: Rend Flesh
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to inflict bleeding on monsters in a small area around the target.

skills.name: Madness Control
skills.description: Hook nearby monsters towards you stunning them and dealing arcane damage. Additionally summon a bomb from the sky onto your location creating an explosion that deals arcane damage.

skills.name: Resilient Gladiator
skills.description: Increases your physical damage reduction and life.

skills.name: Annihilation
skills.description: Violently rip all serrated chains out of monsters dealing area of effect damage. Targets affected by retiarius net take increased damage.

name: Plague Doctor
title: The Fatal Remedy
description: Prescribe poison and let the diagnosis spread. The Plague Doctor fights with toxic flasks, rats, and leeches, or opens wounds with surgical blades, gaining damage and life steal against bleeding targets.

skills.name: Surgical Blood Letting
skills.description: Throw a surgical knife with razor sharp accuracy that bounces from monster to monster dealing physical damage.

skills.name: Malpractice
skills.description: Increases the force of surgical blood letting causing targets to bleed.

skills.name: Crow Mask's Presence
skills.description: Increases your life and all resistances.

skills.name: Blood Sustenance
skills.description: Gain increased attack damage and life stolen per hit from bleeding targets.

skills.name: Miasma
skills.description: Empower your attack with a mixture of chemicals causing the monster to release a toxic cloud dealing physical damage.

skills.name: Booster Shot
skills.description: When attacking have a chance to inject yourself with a mRNA gene altering shot temporarily increasing your attack damage and movement speed.

skills.name: Lifeblood Aura
skills.description: When active, increases your and your party members Life and life replenish.

skills.name: Devout Doctor
skills.description: Gain physical damage based on your maximum life.

skills.name: Defunct Surgeon
skills.description: Temporarily increase your attack speed and life stolen per hit. When active lose a portion of your maximum life per second (Non-fatal).

skills.name: Plague of Rats
skills.description: Send plague rats in target direction dealing poison damage on impact.

skills.name: Toxic Flask
skills.description: Throw a bouncing toxic flask towards target location dealing poison damage.

skills.name: Crematus
skills.description: Unleash a breath of toxic flames dealing poison damage.

skills.name: Oops
skills.description: Toxic flask also leaves a pool of poisonous substance on the ground dealing poison damage, poisoning and slowing monsters. Oops.

skills.name: Chant of Weakness
skills.description: Poisoned targets take increased poison damage.

skills.name: Exploding Mice
skills.description: Plague of Rats explode on impact causing poison damage.

skills.name: Jar of Leeches
skills.description: Throw a glass jar towards target location releasing leeches dealing poison damage on impact.

skills.name: Plague Master
skills.description: Cause all poisoned targets on target location to spread the plague and deal poison damage to monsters around them.

skills.name: Randy the Rancid Rat
skills.description: Summon randy the rancid rat to fight for you dealing poison damage.

name: Shield Lancer
title: The Unbroken Line
description: Plant the banner and make the enemy come to you. The Shield Lancer strengthens allies, pierces the ranks with lance attacks, and turns shield defense, taunts, and counterstrikes into a punishing stand at the front.

skills.name: Glorious Strike
skills.description: Perform a powerful attack dealing physical area of effect damage.

skills.name: Commending Banner
skills.description: Place a commending banner on the target location increasing nearby players attack speed and attack rating.

skills.name: Battle Charge
skills.description: Charge towards target location knocking monsters up and dealing arcane damage on impact.

skills.name: Lance Thrust
skills.description: Perform a long ranged lance attack piercing monsters in a line dealing physical damage. If the lance comes in contact with a commending banner you get dragged to the banner smashing the ground stunning monsters on impact.

skills.name: Parry
skills.description: Gives you a chance to parry incoming attacks.

skills.name: Armor Crush
skills.description: Battle charge inflicts armor break and lowers monster attack rating on hit.

skills.name: Crushing Lance
skills.description: Call a crushing lance down from the sky smashing the target location dealing area of effect physical damage.

skills.name: Lance Throw
skills.description: When using any of the abilities, you have a chance to throw a piercing lance at a nearby monster dealing physical damage.

skills.name: Glory
skills.description: Gain increased attack damage and magic skill damage for a short period.

skills.name: Shield Slam
skills.description: Strike with your shield dealing physical damage based on the defense of your shield.

skills.name: Taunt
skills.description: Taunt monsters to attack you. Additional points increase the monster amount and duration.

skills.name: Counter
skills.description: When active all monster attacks get countered with thrusting lances dealing arcane damage.

skills.name: Knight's Resilience
skills.description: Increases your life and all resistances.

skills.name: Damage Reflect
skills.description: Increases your damage return.

skills.name: Honed Defenses
skills.description: Every time you get hit by a monster attack gain stacks. At maximum stacks unleash a huge area of effect pulse dealing arcane damage to monsters around you. Can also be casted early to consume the stacks.

skills.name: Shield Wall
skills.description: Cast a wall of shields around you blocking monster projectiles dealing arcane and physical damage on hit. Hitting an enemy with Shield Wall generates a Honed Defenses stack.

skills.name: Knight´s Vigor
skills.description: Gain increased maximum life and vitality.

skills.name: Last Stand
skills.description: Restore yourself to full life and temporarily gain increased magic skill damage and physical damage reduction.

name: Jötunn
title: Winter Made Flesh
description: Bring the frozen tundra crashing into battle. The Jötunn commands blizzards and ice orbs, freezes enemies with brutal leaps and strikes, and invokes Aurgelmir to become a war machine of cold and crushing force.

skills.name: Frozen Boulder
skills.description: Throw a frozen boulder dealing cold damage to monsters on its path.

skills.name: Breath of Ice
skills.description: Breathe glacial air freezing and dealing cold damage to monsters.

skills.name: Power of the Ancients
skills.description: Gain additional cold skill damage based on your mana.

skills.name: Orb of Frost
skills.description: Cast a frozen orb traveling in target direction releasing icicles, freezing and dealing cold damage to monsters on its path.

skills.name: Frozen Hide
skills.description: Cast a frost enhanced shield on yourself reducing incoming physical damage, freezing and dealing cold damage to monsters that attack you.

skills.name: Icicles
skills.description: Every 5th time you cast a spell also release Icicles dealing cold damage.

skills.name: Portal of Ice
skills.description: Teleport to the target location and release a frost nova dealing cold damage.

skills.name: Avatar of Frost
skills.description: Increases your cold skill damage.

skills.name: Blizzard
skills.description: Cast a freezing blizzard dealing area of effect cold damage and freezing monsters in the target area.

skills.name: Glacial Tremors
skills.description: Every 4th attack unleashes an area of effect blast dealing cold damage.

skills.name: Flash Freeze
skills.description: Perform an attack enhanced with ice that unleashes a chaining orb of ice, exploding into icicles at the end dealing additional cold damage.

skills.name: Freezing Leap
skills.description: Leap through the air into target location freezing and dealing cold damage to monsters when landing.

skills.name: Permafrost
skills.description: Frozen monsters have a chance explode into an area of effect pulse when shattered.

skills.name: Glacial Armor
skills.description: Increases your all resistances.

skills.name: Frost Sunder
skills.description: Unleash a barrage of piercing icicles dealing cold and physical damage freezing on hit.

skills.name: Avalanche
skills.description: Release a bellowing shout dealing cold damage to all monsters around you and freezing them.

skills.name: Absolute Zero
skills.description: Applies Cold Break on Attack.

skills.name: The Embodiment of Aurgelmir
skills.description: Summon the power of Aurgelmir and temporarily turn into a war machine of the frozen tundra increasing your attack damage, attack speed and life replenish.

name: Illusionist
title: The Fractured Hour
description: Let the enemy fight a battlefield that refuses to stay real. The Illusionist commands Sand Guardians, bends gravity and time, and summons fractal heroes while slipping through dimensions and leaving an explosive double behind.

skills.name: Sand Guardians
skills.description: Conjure a Sand Guardian that attacks nearby monsters dealing arcane damage.

skills.name: Piercing Sand
skills.description: Sand Guardians break monster arcane resistances on attack.

skills.name: Call For War
skills.description: Command all Sand Guardians to charge to target area. Passively increases Sand Guardian dash range.

skills.name: Link of Sand
skills.description: Pull yourself into the closest Sand Guardian in the target location temporarily empowering all nearby Sand Guardians arcane damage.

skills.name: Dissipation
skills.description: Sand Guardians explode upon expiration dealing area of effect arcane damage.

skills.name: Spirit Link
skills.description: Link of Sand increases your magic skill damage and physical damage reduction for a short period.

skills.name: Cheapshot
skills.description: Sand Guardians gain a chance to deal a deadly attack with increased arcane damage and stunning their target.

skills.name: Circle of Guardians
skills.description: Conjure a circle of Sand Guardians around you increasing Sand Guardians’ arcane damage.

skills.name: Combat Order
skills.description: Sand Guardians gain a chance to perform an area of effect attack dealing arcane damage.

skills.name: Age Proliferation
skills.description: Channel waves of fractal energy on the target monster sending pulses out dealing arcane damage to nearby monsters.

skills.name: Gravitation Slam
skills.description: Raise monsters in target location into the air smashing them down with quantum force dealing arcane damage.

skills.name: Split Reality
skills.description: Detach from your quantum self leaving your fractal self behind that explodes when coming in contact with a monster dealing arcane damage.

skills.name: Sands of Time
skills.description: Temporarily increase your arcane skill damage and cast rate.

skills.name: Time Deceleration
skills.description: Break time and space causing all nearby monsters to take arcane damage and Slowing them.

skills.name: Dimensional Displacement
skills.description: Warp a short distance towards target location temporarily gaining increased movement speed.

skills.name: Precognition
skills.description: Increases your arcane skill damage.

skills.name: Expansive Mind
skills.description: Increases your mana and mana replenish.

skills.name: Temporal Heroes
skills.description: Summon a fractal Viking, Pyromancer and Marksman to fight on your side.

name: Exo
title: Sunfire and Moonfall
description: Become the sun that burns, or the moon that draws everything inward. Exo channels solar fire into flares and supernovas, while lunar power summons freezing waves, orbiting moons, and black holes that pull enemies together.

skills.name: Scorching Whip
skills.description: Cast a scorching solar flare that whips forward dealing fire damage to monsters hit.

skills.name: Whiplash
skills.description: Scorching Whip now creates a chaining fire ball that bounces between monsters. Fire balls can hit the same target multiple times.

skills.name: Solar Flare
skills.description: Unleash solar flare projectiles that homes towards monsters.

skills.name: Shine Bright
skills.description: Gain increased movement speed and attack speed.

skills.name: Solar Dash
skills.description: Turn into a burning ball of fire traveling towards target location dealing fire damage leaving a trail of flames behind you.

skills.name: Blinding Light
skills.description: You emit a blinding light that gives you chance to evade monster attacks. You also have increased cast rate while in Solar Form

skills.name: Solar Form
skills.description: Turn into a living sun and gain additional fire damage. Every time you cast an active ability in solar form you unleash a fiery pulse around you.

skills.name: Solar Burst
skills.description: When you kill a monster, summon a burning burst of solar fire beneath the dead monster that deals area of effect fire damage.

skills.name: Supernova
skills.description: Explode into a supernova dealing fire damage on a large radius.

skills.name: Collision
skills.description: Leap forward from your orbit and smash the ground dealing cold damage in an area. Then dash forward on the surface of earth for short period of time and deal cold damage.

skills.name: Dark Side of the Moon
skills.description: While active, slow monsters around you. Also increases your mana replenish and energy.

skills.name: Tsunami
skills.description: Direct your lunar mass to cast a wave of tsunami forward dealing cold damage.

skills.name: Asteroid
skills.description: Cast down an asteroid from the sky dealing cold damage when landing.

skills.name: Lunar Form
skills.description: Turn into a living moon and gain additional cold damage. Every time you jump, cast Collision instead.

skills.name: Lunar Orbit
skills.description: Unleash small moons in your orbit dealing cold damage on hit.

skills.name: Blood Moon
skills.description: Turn the orbiting moons into blood moons increasing their cold damage and causing them to inflict bleeding on hit.

skills.name: Moonlight
skills.description: Increases your movement speed and cold damage dealt.

skills.name: Black Hole
skills.description: Cast a black hole on target location that slows and pulls monsters towards it dealing cold damage.

name: Butcher
title: Hunger Without Mercy
description: Drag enemies close with meat hooks and open them with bleeding cuts. The Butcher trades damage for sustain in Holy Form, or sacrifices life for greater damage in Unholy Form, balancing brutality against its own survival.

skills.name: Slicing Throw
skills.description: Throw your weapon like a boomerang returning back to you dealing physical damage to monsters on its path. You can activate Daisy's Call to re-appear where the last thrown slicing throw is at any point in the flight.

skills.name: Furious Strike
skills.description: Perform a powerful area of effect attack dealing physical damage and infecting monsters struck with a stack of rabies. Each stack of rabies increases attack damage dealt to the monster.

skills.name: Holy Form
skills.description: Activate Holy Form gaining increased life replenish and life steal at the cost of damage dealt. Any damage dealt while in this form is decreased.

skills.name: Unholy Form
skills.description: Activate Unholy Form gaining increased damage at the cost inflicting a portion of your max life as damage to your self every time you cast, attack or proc something. Any life replenish when in this form is lowered.

skills.name: Sacrilegious Scorn
skills.description: While in Holy Form gain increased attack speed and while in Unholy Form gain increased Critical damage.

skills.name: Ending Fate
skills.description: While in Holy Form gain increased base life regen after killing a monster and while in Unholy Form rip the monster apart after killing a monster causing huge area of effect damage.

skills.name: Spiritual Duality
skills.description: While in Holy Form increases your life Per Hit and while in Unholy Form increases your attack damage.

skills.name: Awakening Fury
skills.description: On hit gain a chance to increase your attack damage for a short duration.

skills.name: Insatiable Hunger
skills.description: Awaken the full potential of both holy and unholy to gain both benefits for a short period of time with increased effectiveness.

skills.name: Chain Rip
skills.description: Perform a powerful attack pulling all nearby monsters infront of you.

skills.name: Brutalizing Slash
skills.description: Attack with brutalizing area of effect attack causing monsters to bleed.

skills.name: Fuel to Fire
skills.description: Increase your damage dealt for a short period of time. Every corpse close to you will be siphoned for additional damage.

skills.name: Hunger For Blood
skills.description: Deal increased damage to bleeding targets.

skills.name: Butchers Hook
skills.description: Flail a huge meat hook around you gathering all monsters struck then pulling and stunning them infront of you.

skills.name: Chain Swing
skills.description: Throw a meat hook that pulls you into it when connecting with monster or environment. Additionally fires chains to nearby monsters when landing.

skills.name: Submerged Knives
skills.description: Smash the ground pushing waves of butchers knives out of the ground dealing massive damage and knocking them up. Deals extra damage to bleeding targets.

skills.name: Enraged Mania
skills.description: Increase attack area of effect range and attack speed.

skills.name: Blender
skills.description: Swing two huge butchers knives around you dealing physical damage.

name: Stormweaver
title: The Gathering Storm
description: Weave the sky's fury into every cast. The Stormweaver fills the battlefield with charged bolts, chain lightning, and thunderclouds, teleporting into position to call down thunderbolts that can strike again when enemies fall.

skills.name: Charged Bolts
skills.description: Unleash multiple sparking bolts of electricity dealing lightning damage on hit.

skills.name: Manafiend
skills.description: Reduce the mana cost of all skills.

skills.name: Pulsing Charge
skills.description: Charged bolts pulse when hitting a monster.

skills.name: Lightning Surge
skills.description: Unleash a surge of lightning dealing lightning damage.

skills.name: Gateway
skills.description: Instantly teleport to target spot.

skills.name: Chain Lightning
skills.description: Lightning Surge now unleashes chain lightning when colliding with a monster.

skills.name: Static Shock
skills.description: Shock target location with static electricity inflicting monsters with static shock dealing lightning damage over time.

skills.name: Storm Cloud
skills.description: Conjure a storm cloud at target location striking monsters with surges of lightning dealing lightning damage.

skills.name: Symphony of Thunder
skills.description: Gain increased lightning damage for a short period of time also zapping all monsters with thunderbolts when hit by a lightning skill.

skills.name: Electric Cells
skills.description: Gain increased flat mana replenish and energy.

skills.name: Storm Bolt
skills.description: Unleash a bolt of lightning dealing area of effect lightning damage.

skills.name: High Voltage Aura
skills.description: Increases your and party members lightning skill damage.

skills.name: Loaded Pulse
skills.description: Storm Bolt now creates an additional static pulse dealing increased area of effect lightning damage.

skills.name: Wave Length
skills.description: Increases the projectile speed of all skills.

skills.name: The Battery Within
skills.description: Gain increased life, mana and all resistances.

skills.name: Hyper Charged
skills.description: Chance on Cast to gain increased faster cast rate for a short period of time.

skills.name: Apocalyptic Thunder
skills.description: Cast a high voltage thunder bolt on target spot stunning and dealing massive area of effect damage.

skills.name: Aftershock
skills.description: Chance on kill to cast Apocalyptic Thunder on the closest monster with increased lightning damage.

name: Bard
title: The Last Encore
description: Make the battlefield your stage and the last note their warning. The Bard weaponizes amplifiers and lightning riffs, then dives into the crowd with physical strikes, pyrotechnics, and a summoned death metal moshpit.

skills.name: Slaying Riffs
skills.description: Drop an amplifier from the sky smashing the ground and send notes towards enemies dealing lightning damage. Dropping an amplifier on another one causes the first one to explode.

skills.name: Insane Riff
skills.description: Every fifth spell cast is empowered with increased lightning damage.

skills.name: Visceral Growl
skills.description: Unleash a visceral growl in a frontal cone dealing lightning damage.

skills.name: Amping Up
skills.description: Chance on spellhit or strike to gain a stack of amping up increasing your cast rate for a short duration.

skills.name: Sacrilegious Symphony
skills.description: Channel for a brief moment before unleashing a massive area of effect pulse around you dealing lightning damage.

skills.name: Satan´s Melody
skills.description: Gain increased lightning skill damage for a short duration and a chance to unleash guitar picks in an arc on hit.

skills.name: Sounds of Silence
skills.description: Converts a portion of your intelligence into lightning skill damage.

skills.name: High dB
skills.description: Notes have a chance to unleash a sonar pulse on hit dealing increased lightning damage.

skills.name: Progenies of the Great Cataclysm
skills.description: Summon a massive amplifier playing black metal at high volume sending piercing notes towards nearby monsters bouncing from terrain dealing lightning damage. If you are too far from the amplifier it is pulled back to your position.

skills.name: Headbanger
skills.description: Every third attack unleashes a headbang dealing area of effect damage.

skills.name: Crowd Pummeler
skills.description: Chance to unleash notes from monsters on hit dealing physical damage.

skills.name: Crowd Dive
skills.description: Charge towards target location knocking monsters up on hit dealing physical damage.

skills.name: Adrenaline Momentum
skills.description: chance to gain a stack of adrenaline momentum on hit increasing your movement speed and attack speed.

skills.name: Craving For Attention
skills.description: Gain fire skill damage for a portion of your total enhanced damage.

skills.name: Pyro Technician
skills.description: Blink into the closest monster to target location unleashing an area of effect attack dealing physical and fire damage.

skills.name: Craving For Another Killing
skills.description: Increases your attack damage, life per hit and attack speed for a short duration.

skills.name: Antisocial Pit Fighter
skills.description: Chance to apply increased magic find on kill.

skills.name: Moshpit Massacre
skills.description: Summon a death metal crowd to fight monsters within the area radius draining a portion of your maximum mana over time dealing physical damage.

name: Prophet
title: The Wild Unbound
description: Call the forest to war, or wear its fury as your own flesh. The Prophet summons ravens and towering ents, spreads poisonous roots, and transforms into a wendigo, an ent, or a storm hawk that unleashes lightning.

skills.name: Carrion Worm
skills.description: Summons a carrion worm frequently attacking nearby monsters.

skills.name: Thorned Roots
skills.description: Unleash a swarm of roots dealing poison damage on hit.

skills.name: Summon Raven
skills.description: Summon a raven circling around you attacking nearby monsters.

skills.name: Blessed Nature
skills.description: Increases poison skill damage.

skills.name: Summon Ent
skills.description: Summons an ent to fight by your side.

skills.name: Thorned Branch
skills.description: Throw a thorned branch dealing poison damage on hit.

skills.name: Summon Spirit of The Forest
skills.description: Summons a spirit of the forest increasing life and mana for you and your party. Only one spirit can be summoned.

skills.name: Deep Rooted
skills.description: Increases all resistances.

skills.name: Summon Ent Colossus
skills.description: Summons an ent colossus to fight by your side.

skills.name: Spirit of The Wendigo
